Panjab men bhajpa aur shiromni akali dal (badal) chhah sal bad phir gathbandhan men aa gae hain. donon dalon ko ummid hai ki unka paranprik vot baink ek-dusre ke sath jur sakega. halanki, kisanon ki narajgi, panthik voton ka bantvara aur kangres va aam aadmi parti ki majbut maujudgi is gathbandhan ke samne bari chunauti hain. kya donon dal ek-dusre ke vot hasil kar paenge?
